description: Holds one filter shape and sends it to a Pole Dancer as a five-channel signal: a dry level and a level for each of the four poles

outputs.text: The five levels on one five-channel cable, written at a divided rate rather than every sample

notes: this module holds no filter until one is loaded: right-click it and choose a preset, which is also what fills in the name on the display
the five levels have no controls on this panel; they come from the presets, or from an Architect expander placed immediately to the right
the name on the display can be typed into, and it is saved with the preset
because the five levels travel as one polyphonic cable, ordinary crossfaders, switches and slew limiters can morph between filter shapes on the way to the Pole Dancer
menu: Add Architect (right side) — places an Architect expander immediately to the right of this module
